name: IDE Context Server
description: WebSocket + lock file server exposing Cockpit IDE's active editor state (file path, selection, selected text) to external tools like opencode CLI. Uses JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket with lock file discovery matching opencode's native protocol (transport: 'ws'). Listens on random port, writes lock files to ~/.claude/ide/{port}.lock (primary) and {xdgData}/opencode/ide/{port}.lock.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Create HTTP + WebSocket server on random port, write lock files

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Remove lock files, close all connections, shut down server

methods.name: updateEditorState
methods.description: Broadcast selection_changed JSON-RPC 2.0 notification to all WebSocket clients

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Return the listening port (0 if not started)

methods.name: getLockPaths
methods.description: Return array of active lock file paths

lifecycle.start: ideServer.start(workspacePath) — creates HTTP server + WebSocketServer on random port, writes lock files with {transport:'ws', workspaceFolders:[path]} format
lifecycle.update: ideServer.updateEditorState(state) — broadcasts selection_changed as JSON-RPC 2.0 notification to all connected WebSocket clients
lifecycle.stop: ideServer.stop() — removes lock files, closes all WebSocket connections, shuts down HTTP server, resets port to 0

lock_file_format.description: JSON file matching opencode's native editor discovery protocol (lock file with transport field for workspace-scoped matching)

fields.transport: 'ws' — signals opencode to connect via WebSocket
fields.workspaceFolders: Array with one element: the absolute workspace path (forward-slash normalized)

websocket_protocol.initialize: Server responds to opencode's 'initialize' method with protocolVersion '2025-11-25' and serverInfo {name:'Cockpit IDE', version:'0.0.1'}. Sends current selection_changed state (if any) immediately after the initialize response.

params.filePath: Absolute path to active file (string), or null if no file open
params.relativePath: Path relative to workspace root (string), or null
params.selection: Object with start/end each having line (1-based) and character (1-based); or null if no selection
